{{Quote|Kral, in the force we lost&hellip;did you have any family?''"<br />"''Yes sir. My son Turl. An ensign. A weapons officer aboard the frigate ''Cheesmeer''.|Jacen Solo and Kral Nevil|<ref name="Fury" />}}
'''Turl Nevil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] serving in the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Second Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] of decorated [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kral Nevil]], he served as a [[Weapons officer/Legends|weapons officer]] aboard the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Cheesmeer]]''.<ref name="Fury" />

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Turl was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] ordered the firing of the [[hyperspace tractor beam]] onboard [[Centerpoint Station]], an ancient [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], during a [[Battle of the rendezvous point|skirmish]] at a [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]] rendezvous point. The ensuing blast destroyed the majority of the Second Fleet, including the ''Cheesmeer'' and all Corellian forces present at the rendezvous point.<ref name="Fury" />

In the aftermath, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], one of two [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chiefs of State]] of the Galactic Alliance, asked Kral if he had lost any family in the destruction. Kral responded by informing him of Turl's death.<ref name="Fury" /> Later in the war, Kral would ask [[Cha Niathal]], the other Chief of State, to ensure his son did not die in vain.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Turl Nevil was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2007]] as the seventh volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Fury" />
